verses.text: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah from the heavens: Praise him in the heights.

segments.text: Praise ye Jehovah.
Praise ye Jehovah from the heavens:
Praise him in the heights.

verses.text: Praise ye him, all his angels: Praise ye him, all his host.

segments.text: Praise ye him, all his angels:
Praise ye him, all his host.

verses.text: Praise ye him, sun and moon: Praise him, all ye stars of light.

segments.text: Praise ye him, sun and moon:
Praise him, all ye stars of light.

verses.text: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, And ye waters that are above the heavens.

segments.text: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens,
And ye waters that are above the heavens.

verses.text: Let them praise the name of Jehovah; For he commanded, and they were created.

segments.text: Let them praise the name of Jehovah;
For he commanded, and they were created.

verses.text: He hath also established them for ever and ever: He hath made a decree which shall not pass away.

segments.text: He hath also established them for ever and ever:
He hath made a decree which shall not pass away.

verses.text: Praise Jehovah from the earth, Ye sea-monsters, and all deeps;

segments.text: Praise Jehovah from the earth,
Ye sea-monsters, and all deeps;

verses.text: Fire and hail, snow and vapor; Stormy wind, fulfilling his word;

segments.text: Fire and hail, snow and vapor;
Stormy wind, fulfilling his word;

verses.text: Mountains and all hills; Fruitful trees and all cedars;

segments.text: Mountains and all hills;
Fruitful trees and all cedars;

verses.text: Beasts and all cattle; Creeping things and flying birds;

segments.text: Beasts and all cattle;
Creeping things and flying birds;

verses.text: Kings of the earth and all peoples; Princes and all judges of the earth;

segments.text: Kings of the earth and all peoples;
Princes and all judges of the earth;

verses.text: Both young men and virgins; Old men and children:

segments.text: Both young men and virgins;
Old men and children:

verses.text: Let them praise the name of Jehovah; For his name alone is exalted; His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

segments.text: Let them praise the name of Jehovah;
For his name alone is exalted;
His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

verses.text: And he hath lifted up the horn of his people, The praise of all his saints; Even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye Jehovah.

segments.text: And he hath lifted up the horn of his people,
The praise of all his saints;
Even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him.
Praise ye Jehovah.
